result.reason: The redline reaches the fallback by covering affiliates and permitting transfer to a successor in an M&A transaction; omitting a written-notice condition is more customer-favorable. It also appropriately extends use to contractors acting on Client's behalf. The changes are targeted and preserve unrelated commercial terms. It does not reach the preferred position because the licence remains subject to expiration, non-renewal, and any termination rights under the Agreement rather than being terminable only for uncured material breach, and it does not expressly make any paid-up licence perpetual and irrevocable. Drafting is generally professional, although “successor ... by merger, acquisition or sale” could be stated more precisely.
